title: 'Historie' Unveils Production Staff, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga revealed the production staff, additional cast, theme songs, key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere as a two-episode special on January 9 at 1:23 a.m.
